items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Baker. He had a 6 piece band.

ctx.x: One day I was so disgusted with playing that same stuff that I picked up my -- and I started to throw it out on the dancefloor but the guitarist stopped me, and kind of come to my senses.

But I stayed with that band up until the time Uncle Sam called. I was up in Monominee, Wisconsin in '43, when Uncle Sam sent me my draft papers. And I was accepted. So I joined Uncle Sam's Army Air Force in September, 1943.
You were 20 years old at that point.
